summary: MaintETopic is a component of the HSPnet application that manages the maintenance of electronic topics (eTopics). It includes functionalities for loading different views such as summaries, applications, and histories. The component uses ASP.NET Web Forms with various user controls and AJAX features.
purpose: The purpose of the MaintETopic component is to provide a user interface for managing eTopics. It allows users to view and update topic-related information, navigate through different views, and handle applications and status histories efficiently.

fields.name: txtETopicID
fields.description: Stores the ID of the current eTopic.

fields.name: uxTopic
fields.description: Displays the name of the eTopic.

fields.name: uxCourse
fields.description: Displays the course name associated with the eTopic.

fields.name: uxRef
fields.description: Displays the reference associated with the eTopic.

fields.name: uxSitesAppliedTo
fields.description: Displays the sites to which the eTopic is applied.

fields.name: uxDisciplinesAppliedTo
fields.description: Displays the disciplines to which the eTopic is applied.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Represents the current user's session information.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Determine and activate default tab based on the current page or query string.
Fetch eTopic information based on provided IDs.

workflows.name: Load History
steps: Set UX status or application history visibility based on parameters.
Switch active view in MultiViewHistory control accordingly.

business_rules: Screen is editable only when user's orientation and agency ID match the eTopic's agency ID, and the user does not have view-only restrictions.
validations: Checks if the eTopic ID and course ID are valid integers.
Ensures that the course ID or eTopic ID is provided. Otherwise, displays an error message.

conditions.description: Determine the active tab based on the current page when the page loads.
Decide visibility and data binding of history views based on user actions and parameters.

system_behavior: Automatically hides or shows error and warning panels based on server-side events.
Uses client-side scripts for dynamic content updates and interaction handling.
dependencies: ASP.NET Web Forms and AJAX Control Toolkit for UI components.
exceptions: Handles missing course ID or eTopic ID by displaying an error and hiding the eTopic info panel.
